That test raised On-Time Delivery Rate by 3.1 pts through relaxed promises, cut checkout conversion by 1.2%, and was not shipped. The proposal does not cite EXP-014. It also uses On-Time Delivery Rate as its sole success metric and has no conversion guardrail, which is the learning EXP-014 warned against.","evidence_quote":"Let customers pick between two delivery windows at checkout, with the later window shown as more reliable.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-014 and explain how this design differs from padding. Judge success on Promise Accuracy and checkout conversion, not On-Time Delivery Rate alone, and add checkout conversion as a guardrail."}]}
